    • Method Detail

      • end

        void end(IMatch match,
         MatchEndReason reason)
        This handles the statistical requirements of ending a match. After completion, it will terminate the match. Ending a match using this method is the correct and safe way to end a match. As compared to terminateMatch(IMatch), this method will handle updating stats, ELO, and other match related data.
        Parameters:
        match - IMatch
        reason - MatchEndReason

      • terminateMatch

        void terminateMatch(IMatch match)
        This cleans up the match and teleports all players and spectators to spawn along with sending them their IPostMatchInventory message. This method is also responsible for handling /leave or /bolt terminate. It's essentially resetting the players and removing the match from memory. This method does NOT handle any statistical requirements of ending a match.
        Parameters:
        match - IMatch

      • fatalEnd

        void fatalEnd(IMatch match,
              java.lang.String reason)
        This method is used to end a match in the event of a critical failure. This should be used sparingly and only in situations where the match cannot continue due to unforeseen circumstances. This method will not handle any statistical requirements of ending a match, it will simply terminate the match and notify all players involved.
        Parameters:
        match - IMatch
        reason - String Reason for the fatal end

      • resetBlocks

        java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture<java.lang.Boolean> resetBlocks(IMatch match)
        Resets all blocks in the match asynchronously. This is used to reset the arena for round cleanups. Like in battle rush, the blocks need to be cleared after each round.
        Parameters:
        match - IMatch
        Returns:
        CompletableFuture of Boolean whether the blocks were reset successfully or not

      • resetArena

        java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture<java.lang.Boolean> resetArena(IMatch match)
        Resets the arena for the match asynchronously. This is used to reset the arena after a match has ended. This will reset both the blocks and the entities in the arena.
        Parameters:
        match - IMatch
        Returns:
        CompletableFuture of Boolean whether the arena was reset successfully or not

      • handleDeath

        void handleDeath(IMatch match,
                 org.bukkit.entity.Player deadPlayer,
                 org.bukkit.entity.Player killerPlayer,
                 MatchDeathReason reason)
        Main method for handling a player's death while in match or a player disconnecting while in match. The reason primarily defines if the player is eligible for a respawn after death or not.
        Parameters:
        match - IMatch The match of player dying
        deadPlayer - Player The player that died or disconnected
        killerPlayer - Player The killer of the player if there is one or else null
        reason - MatchDeathReason What was the cause of their death?

      • createSoloRankedMatch

        @Nullable
@Nullable IMatch createSoloRankedMatch(org.bukkit.entity.Player playerA,
                                                  org.bukkit.entity.Player playerB,
                                                  IKit kit)
        Creates and starts a solo ranked match between two players using the specified kit. An arena will be automatically selected. If no arena is available, null is returned. This is useful for external integrations (e.g., Discord bots) to force-start ranked matches programmatically.
        Parameters:
        playerA - The first player
        playerB - The second player
        kit - The kit to use for the match
        Returns:
        The created IMatch, or null if the match could not be created
